jobSeekerInfo.formSubtitle: Our form is designed to be quick and easy. Here's what you'll need:
jobSeekerInfo.formOptionalNote: Resume upload and profile photo are completely optional
jobSeekerInfo.faq1Question: How do I apply for a job?
jobSeekerInfo.faq1Answer: Simply register on our platform by filling out the profile form. Our team will review your profile and match you with suitable job openings. You don't need to apply for individual jobs — we do the matching for you.
jobSeekerInfo.faq2Question: Do I need a resume to register?
jobSeekerInfo.faq2Answer: No, a resume is optional. You can fill in all your details directly in the registration form. However, if you have a resume, uploading it can speed up the process.
jobSeekerInfo.faq3Question: Is there any fee for registration?
jobSeekerInfo.faq3Answer: No, registration is completely free for job seekers. There are no charges at any stage of the process.
jobSeekerInfo.faq4Question: How will I know if I'm matched with a job?
jobSeekerInfo.faq4Answer: Once matched, our agent will contact you via phone or email with the job details. You can then decide to proceed with the interview.
jobSeekerInfo.faq5Question: Can I apply for jobs in another state?
jobSeekerInfo.faq5Answer: Yes! During registration, indicate your willingness to relocate and specify your preferred locations. We'll match you with opportunities in those areas.
jobSeekerInfo.faq6Question: What types of jobs are available?
jobSeekerInfo.faq6Answer: We have openings across manufacturing, healthcare, IT, agriculture, logistics, construction, education, and more. Both full-time and part-time positions are available.

aboutUs.title: About Rojgaar Hai
aboutUs.subtitle: Connecting talent with opportunity — meaningfully, reliably, and effectively.
aboutUs.p1: Rojgaar Hai is a people-first recruitment platform created to make the connection between talent and opportunity more meaningful, reliable, and effective. We understand that finding the right job is not simply about applying to multiple openings, and hiring the right person is not simply about filling a vacancy. Both are important decisions that can shape careers, teams, and businesses for years to come.
aboutUs.p2: Powered by Pacific Jobs, Rojgaar Hai brings together practical recruitment experience, industry understanding, and a modern digital approach to create a better hiring experience for both job seekers and employers.
aboutUs.purposeP1: For job seekers, we aim to provide access to genuine opportunities that match their skills, experience, ambitions, and career direction. Whether someone is starting their professional journey, looking for a better role, returning to the workforce, or preparing for the next stage of their career, Rojgaar Hai is designed to help them discover opportunities where they can grow and move forward with confidence.
aboutUs.purposeP2: For employers, we focus on helping organisations reach the right talent instead of simply receiving more applications. Every business has different hiring needs, expectations, cultures, and challenges. By creating stronger connections between employers and relevant candidates, we aim to make recruitment more efficient while helping organisations build capable and dependable teams.
aboutUs.beliefP1: At the heart of Rojgaar Hai is a simple belief: good recruitment is about finding the right match. A candidate is more than a resume, and a job is more than a designation. The best outcomes happen when skills, aspirations, expectations, and opportunities come together in the right way.
aboutUs.beliefP2: With the recruitment experience and industry foundation of Pacific Jobs behind us, Rojgaar Hai is building a platform where opportunities are easier to discover, talent is easier to recognise, and meaningful professional connections are easier to create.
aboutUs.beliefP3: Because the right opportunity can shape a career, and the right person can make a real difference to a business.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.section1Body: When you register as a candidate or employer, we collect information you provide directly — name, email, phone number, resume details, work experience, company information, and job postings. We also collect usage data such as pages visited and jobs viewed to improve matching quality.
privacyPolicy.section2Body: We use your information to create and manage your account, match candidates with relevant job openings, allow employers to review applicants, send you relevant notifications, and improve our platform. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacyPolicy.section3Body: Candidate profile information (name, contact details, resume, skills, experience) is shared with employers when you apply to their job postings or when a recruiter matches you to a role. Employer company information is visible to candidates browsing job listings.
privacyPolicy.section4Body: We use industry-standard security practices, including encrypted connections and access controls, to protect your data. Passwords are never stored in plain text.
privacyPolicy.section5Body: You can review and update your profile information at any time from your dashboard. To request account deletion or have questions about your data, contact us at support@rojgaarhai.com.
privacyPolicy.section6Body: We use essential cookies to keep you logged in and remember your preferences. We do not use third-party advertising trackers.
privacyPolicy.section7Body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via the platform or email.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1Body: By creating an account or using Rojgaar Hai, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
terms.section2Body: Candidates must be at least 18 years old or have guardian consent as applicable under Indian law. Employers must provide accurate company information and hold the authority to post job openings on behalf of their organization.
terms.section3Body: You agree to provide accurate, current information when creating your profile or posting a job. Rojgaar Hai reserves the right to suspend accounts found to contain false or misleading information.
terms.section4Body: All job postings are reviewed before going live. Employers are responsible for the legality and accuracy of their listings. Candidates apply to jobs at their own discretion; Rojgaar Hai facilitates the connection but is not a party to any resulting employment relationship.
terms.section5Body: Users may not post fraudulent job listings, misrepresent their identity or qualifications, scrape or misuse platform data, or use the platform for any unlawful purpose.
terms.section6Body: Rojgaar Hai may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, engage in fraudulent activity, or misuse the platform.
terms.section7Body: Rojgaar Hai provides a platform to connect candidates and employers. We do not guarantee employment outcomes and are not liable for the conduct of any user, employer, or candidate on the platform.
terms.section8Body: We may update these terms periodically. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
terms.section9Body: Questions about these terms can be sent to support@rojgaarhai.com.
